reference_comparison.notes: REF-002 uses detailed, textured characters/props (clothing folds, boots, scarves), rich environment set dressing, sunlit HDR lighting with soft GI and depth. Render is clean and coherent stylized 3D but sparse: bare walls, mannequin-jointed character with mitten hands, primitive indoor box in S004, flat sky/grass. Mechanism labeling is a strength vs REF. Framing repeatedly clips key subjects; REF keeps subject centred with full silhouettes.
